findings.summary: No tests cover kick_throttle_seconds(), OFFICE_KICK_THROTTLE_SECONDS validation and fallback cases (unset, zero, negative, non-numeric, NaN/Inf), or kick() honoring the configured throttle window, so regressions in throttle parsing or enforcement will go undetected.

Large finite OFFICE_KICK_THROTTLE_SECONDS values pass kick_throttle_seconds() because it only checks math.isfinite(value) and value >= 0, causing timedelta(seconds=...) or datetime subtraction to raise OverflowError and crash kick().
